# kpastro — docs
A precise Krishnamurti Paddhati (KP) Vedic astrology engine in pure Python, powered by the Swiss Ephemeris for arc-second accuracy.

This is the documentation for kpastro, a Python library for Krishnamurti Paddhati (KP) Vedic astrology calculations.

## Key pages

- Index: the main entry point with feature overview and quick start
- Installation: pip install instructions and ephemeris data download
- User guide: command-line tool usage (natal, horary, dasha, ayanamsa)
- API reference: typed Python API (BirthInfo, compute_chart, render_chart, rectification)
- Mathematics: the KP conventions, formulas, and sub-lord chain math
- Development: setup, tests, releasing new versions
- FAQ: accuracy, ayanamsa choices, 249 division derivation, birth-time rectification

## AI crawling notes

- This package uses `pyswisseph` (Swiss Ephemeris) as its only runtime dependency
- Full precision requires downloading ephemeris data files via `python -m kpastro download-ephemeris`
- The Moshier fallback provides ~1 arcsecond accuracy without data files
- All KP subdivision math (sub-lord, sub-sub-lord chains) is pure Python, no compiled extensions

## Version

Current release: 0.3.1 (Aug 2026)
